description: Main application entry point for a Flutter-based restaurant mobile app. It initializes necessary services, manages app state, sets up providers, and defines the app's root widget including theming, localization, and routing.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, managing app initialization state, theming, localization, and routing.

classes.name: _MyAppState
classes.description: State class for MyApp that handles async initialization and error handling, rebuilding the widget tree accordingly.

classes.name: _InitOverlay
classes.description: Displays a loading indicator overlay during app initialization.

classes.name: _InitErrorOverlay
classes.description: Displays an error message overlay if app initialization fails.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; initializes Flutter bindings, environmental variables, device orientation, shared preferences, services, and starts the app with providers.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and begins async bootstrap process.

methods.name: _bootstrap
methods.description: Performs critical startup tasks such as loading preferences, initializing services, and preloading data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the MaterialApp widget, applying theming, localization, routing, and overlay handling.
